_comment: Substitutions applied to vendored crate sources when rebuilding the vendor
directory without registry access.  Every entry is a plain text replacement
in one file of one crate, and each one exists solely to relax a minimum
version bound that the offline mirror cannot satisfy; none of them changes
compiled behaviour.  A normal `cargo build` against crates.io never sees

syn 2.0.90.reason: the offline mirror only has proc-macro2 1.0.89; syn 2.0.90 uses no API added in 1.0.90/1.0.91
